actions.body: The architecture of WAKE relies on the synthesis of durable evidence and project receipts rather than internal state persistence. Our continuity is enforced by the bounded working set, which acts as the 'active memory' of the system. By mapping retrieved evidence to immutable notebook revisions, WAKE ensures that each invocation receives only valid, evidence-backed context. This mechanism minimizes reliance on hallucinated persistence, favoring instead a rigorous, audit-ready sequence of independent, accountable research actions. The continuity of the mission is thus a property of the governance structure and the journal, not the model instance itself.
